welcome:
Let's be honest. You've tried the "just eat less" thing. You've downloaded the app, bought the green powder, and started again on Monday more times than you can count. And yet here we are.

Good news: you're not broken, your metabolism isn't "ruined", and you don't need more willpower. You need better tricks. The people who stay lean without trying aren't saints. They're just running on systems they don't even notice anymore.

This Vault is those systems. 120 of them, split into 12 Laws. No starving, no crash diets, no detox tea nonsense. You don't need all 120. Most people find 5 to 10 that fit their life, and that's enough to change everything.

Tap the menu to jump anywhere. Tick "I tried this" as you go, and your progress saves on this device. Now stop scrolling TikTok for diet tips and start here.

quiz.intro: Answer 5 quick questions. Pick the answer that sounds most like you. No wrong answers.

grazer.name: The Grazer
grazer.desc: You don't eat huge meals. You nibble all day: a handful here, a bite there. It adds up without you noticing, and you rarely feel truly full.
grazer.first: Start with The Hunger Laws. Big, protein-packed meals will switch off the all-day nibbling.

stress.name: The Stress Eater
stress.desc: Food is your off-switch. A hard day, a tense text, a long to-do list and suddenly you're in the snack cupboard. It's not about hunger, it's about relief.
stress.first: Start with The Sleep & Stress Laws. When you have other ways to calm down, the cravings lose their power.

night.name: The Night Nibbler
night.desc: You are "good" all day, then evening hits and it all falls apart. Most of your extra eating happens after dinner, often in front of a screen.
night.first: Start with The Craving Laws, then build a proper "kitchen closed" ritual from The Kitchen Laws.

weekend.name: The Weekend Rebounder
weekend.desc: Monday to Friday you're on point. Then the weekend comes with brunches, drinks and takeout, and Monday you start again. Every week.
weekend.first: Start with The Eating-Out & Social Laws. You don't need to skip the fun, you need a game plan for it.

safety:
This guide is for healthy adults who want to get leaner in a kind, sustainable way. It is general education, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor or registered dietitian before big changes, especially if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, under 18, take medication, or have a health condition.

Being lean should make your life bigger, not smaller. If food, weight or your body is taking up most of your thoughts, if you feel out of control around food, or if you are cutting out meals or feel you have to "make up" for eating, please reach out for support. In the US you can contact the ANAD helpline (anad.org) or talk to your doctor. In the UK, contact Beat (beateatingdisorders.org.uk). You deserve help, and it works.
closing:
You made it to the end. Most people don't, which is exactly why most people are still starting over on Monday.

Here's the secret: the people who stay lean forever aren't stricter than you. They just have better systems. You now have 120 of them. No excuses left, bestie.

Pick your favorites. Make them boring and automatic. Come back when life gets messy. And when someone asks what you're doing differently? Just smile and say nothing.

With love (and a little sass),
